knight.name: Knight
knight.description: A tough melee fighter. The Barbarian's handsome, cultured cousin. Rumor has it that he was knighted based on the sheer awesomeness of his mustache alone.

archers.name: Archers
archers.description: A pair of lightly armored ranged attackers. They'll help you take down ground and air units, but you're on your own with hair coloring advice.

goblins.name: Goblins
goblins.description: Four fast, unarmored melee attackers. Small, fast, green and mean!

giant.name: Giant
giant.description: Slow but durable, only attacks buildings. A real one-man wrecking crew!

pekka.name: P.E.K.K.A
pekka.description: A heavily armored, slow melee fighter. Swings from the hip, but packs a huge punch.

minions.name: Minions
minions.description: Three fast, unarmored flying attackers. Roses are red, minions are blue, they can fly, and will crush you!

balloon.name: Balloon
balloon.description: As pretty as they are, you won't want a parade of THESE balloons showing up on the horizon. Drops powerful bombs and when shot down, crashes dealing area damage.

witch.name: Witch
witch.description: Summons Skeletons, shoots destructo beams, has glowing pink eyes that unfortunately don't shoot lasers.

barbarians.name: Barbarians
barbarians.description: A horde of melee attackers with mean mustaches and even meaner tempers.

golem.name: Golem
golem.description: Slow but durable, only attacks buildings. When destroyed, explosively splits into two Golemites and deals area damage!

skeletons.name: Skeletons
skeletons.description: Three fast, very weak melee fighters. Surround your enemies with this pile of bones!

valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
valkyrie.description: Tough melee fighter, deals area damage around her. Swarm or horde, no problem! She can take them all out with a few spins.

skeleton-army.name: Skeleton Army
skeleton-army.description: Spawns an army of Skeletons. Meet Larry and his friends Harry, Gerry, Terry, Mary, etc.

bomber.name: Bomber
bomber.description: Small, lightly protected skeleton who throws bombs. Deals area damage that can wipe out a swarm of enemies.

musketeer.name: Musketeer
musketeer.description: Don't be fooled by her delicately coiffed hair, the Musketeer is a mean shot with her trusty boomstick.

baby-dragon.name: Baby Dragon
baby-dragon.description: Burps fireballs from the sky that deal area damage. Baby dragons hatch cute, hungry and ready for a barbeque.

prince.name: Prince
prince.description: Don't let the little pony fool you. Once the Prince gets a running start, you WILL be trampled. Deals double damage once he gets charging.

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.description: The most awesome man to ever set foot in the Arena, the Wizard will blow you away with his handsomeness... and/or fireballs.

mini-pekka.name: Mini P.E.K.K.A
mini-pekka.description: The Arena is a certified butterfly-free zone. No distractions for P.E.K.K.A, only destruction.

spear-goblins.name: Spear Goblins
spear-goblins.description: Three unarmored ranged attackers. Who the heck taught these guys to throw spears!? Who thought that was a good idea?!

giant-skeleton.name: Giant Skeleton
giant-skeleton.description: The bigger the skeleton, the bigger the bomb. Carries a bomb that blows up when the Giant Skeleton dies.

hog-rider.name: Hog Rider
hog-rider.description: Fast melee troop that targets buildings and can jump over the river. He followed the echoing call of "Hog Riderrrrr" all the way through the Arena doors.

minion-horde.name: Minion Horde
minion-horde.description: Six fast, unarmored flying attackers. Three's a crowd, six is a horde!

ice-wizard.name: Ice Wizard
ice-wizard.description: This chill caster throws ice shards that slow down enemies' movement and attack speed. Despite being freezing cold, he has a handlebar mustache that's too hot for TV.

royal-giant.name: Royal Giant
royal-giant.description: Destroying enemy buildings with his massive cannon is his job; making a raggedy blond beard look good is his passion.

guards.name: Guards
guards.description: Three ruthless bone brothers with shields. Knock off their shields and all that's left are three ruthless bone brothers.

princess.name: Princess
princess.description: This stunning Princess shoots flaming arrows from long range. If you're feeling warm feelings towards her, it's probably because you're on fire.

dark-prince.name: Dark Prince
dark-prince.description: The Dark Prince deals area damage and lets his spiked club do the talking for him - because when he does talk, it sounds like he has a bucket on his head.

three-musketeers.name: Three Musketeers
three-musketeers.description: Trio of powerful, independent markswomen, fighting for justice and honor. Disrespecting them would not be just a mistake, it would be a cardinal sin!

lava-hound.name: Lava Hound
lava-hound.description: The Lava Hound is a majestic flying beast that attacks buildings. The Lava Pups are less majestic angry babies that attack anything.

ice-spirit.name: Ice Spirit
ice-spirit.description: Spawns one lively little Ice Spirit to freeze a group of enemies. Stay frosty.

fire-spirit.name: Fire Spirit
fire-spirit.description: The Fire Spirit is on a kamikaze mission to give you a warm hug. It'd be adorable if it wasn't on fire.

miner.name: Miner
miner.description: The Miner can burrow his way underground and appear anywhere in the Arena. It's not magic, it's a shovel. A shovel that deals reduced damage to Crown Towers.

sparky.name: Sparky
sparky.description: Sparky slowly charges up, then unloads MASSIVE area damage. Overkill isn't in her vocabulary.

bowler.name: Bowler
bowler.description: This big blue dude digs the simple things in life - Dark Elixir drinks and throwing rocks. His massive boulders roll through their target, hitting everything behind for a strike!

lumberjack.name: Lumberjack
lumberjack.description: He chops trees by day and hunts The Log by night. His bottle of Rage spills everywhere when he's defeated.

battle-ram.name: Battle Ram
battle-ram.description: Two Barbarians holding a big log charge at the nearest building, dealing significant damage if they connect; then they go to town with their swords!

inferno-dragon.name: Inferno Dragon
inferno-dragon.description: Shoots a focused beam of fire that increases in damage over time. Wears a helmet because flying can be dangerous.

ice-golem.name: Ice Golem
ice-golem.description: He's tough, targets buildings and explodes when destroyed, slowing nearby enemies. Made entirely out of ice... or is he?! Yes.

mega-minion.name: Mega Minion
mega-minion.description: Flying, armored and powerful. What could be its weakness?! Cupcakes.

dart-goblin.name: Dart Goblin
dart-goblin.description: Runs fast, shoots far and chews gum. How does he blow darts with a mouthful of Double Trouble Gum? Years of didgeridoo lessons.

goblin-gang.name: Goblin Gang
goblin-gang.description: Spawns six Goblins - three with knives, three with spears - at a discounted Elixir cost. It's like a Goblin Value Pack!

electro-wizard.name: Electro Wizard
electro-wizard.description: He lands with a "POW!", stuns nearby enemies and shoots lightning with both hands! What a show off.

elite-barbarians.name: Elite Barbarians
elite-barbarians.description: Spawns a pair of leveled up Barbarians. They're like regular Barbarians, only harder, better, faster and stronger.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: He deals BIG damage up close - not so much at range. What he lacks in accuracy, he makes up for with his impressively bushy eyebrows.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.description: He throws his axe like a boomerang, striking all enemies on the way out AND back. It's a miracle he doesn't lose an arm.

bandit.name: Bandit
bandit.description: The Bandit dashes to her target and delivers an extra big hit! While dashing, she can't be touched. The mask keeps her identity safe, and gives her bonus cool points!

royal-recruits.name: Royal Recruits
royal-recruits.description: Deploys a line of recruits armed with spears, shields and wooden buckets. They dream of ponies and one day wearing metal buckets.

night-witch.name: Night Witch
night-witch.description: Summons Bats to do her bidding! If you get too close, she's not afraid of pitching in with her mean-looking battle staff.

bats.name: Bats
bats.description: Spawns a handful of tiny flying creatures. Think of them as sweet, purple... balls of DESTRUCTION!

royal-ghost.name: Royal Ghost
royal-ghost.description: He drifts invisibly through the Arena until he's startled by an enemy... then he attacks! Then he's invisible again! Zzzz.

ram-rider.name: Ram Rider
ram-rider.description: Together they charge through the Arena; snaring enemies, knocking down towers ... and chewing grass!?

zappies.name: Zappies
zappies.description: Spawns a pack of miniature Zap machines. Who controls them...? Only the Master Builder knows.

rascals.name: Rascals
rascals.description: Spawns a mischievous trio of Rascals! The boy takes the lead, while the girls pelt enemies from behind... with slingshots full of Double Trouble Gum!

cannon-cart.name: Cannon Cart
cannon-cart.description: A Cannon on wheels?! Bet they won't see that coming! Once you break its shield, it becomes a Cannon not on wheels.

mega-knight.name: Mega Knight
mega-knight.description: He lands with the force of 1,000 mustaches, then jumps from one foe to the next dealing huge area damage. Stand aside!

skeleton-barrel.name: Skeleton Barrel
skeleton-barrel.description: It's a Skeleton party in the sky, until all the balloons pop... then it's a Skeleton party on the ground!

flying-machine.name: Flying Machine
flying-machine.description: The Master Builder has sent his first contraption to the Arena! It's a fast and fun flying machine, but fragile!

wall-breakers.name: Wall Breakers
wall-breakers.description: A daring duo of dangerous dive bombers. Nothing warms a Wall Breaker's cold and undead heart like blowing up buildings.

royal-hogs.name: Royal Hogs
royal-hogs.description: The King's personal pets are loose! They love to chomp on apples and towers alike - who let the hogs out?!

goblin-giant.name: Goblin Giant
goblin-giant.description: This jolly green Goblin Giant stomps towards enemy buildings. He carries two Spear Goblins everywhere he goes. It's a weird but functional arrangement.

fisherman.name: Fisherman
fisherman.description: His Ranged Attack can pull enemies towards him, and pull himself to enemy buildings. He's also mastered the ancient art of 'Fish Slapping'.

magic-archer.name: Magic Archer
magic-archer.description: Not quite a Wizard, nor an Archer - he shoots a magic arrow that passes through and damages all enemies in its path. It's not a trick, it's magic!

electro-dragon.name: Electro Dragon
electro-dragon.description: Spits out bolts of electricity hitting up to three targets. Suffers from middle child syndrome to boot.

firecracker.name: Firecracker
firecracker.description: Shoots a firework that explodes upon impact, damaging the target and showering anything directly behind it with sparks. This is what happens when Archers get bored!

mighty-miner.name: Mighty Miner
mighty-miner.description:
Walk softly ... and carry a big drill!

This Champion deals increasing Damage to his target and can switch lanes to escape combat or change attack plans.

This makes him not only the mightiest, but also the sneakiest Miner in the Arena.

current.ability: The Mighty Miner has a special ability, accessible from the rightmost side of the screen just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1-second delay, the Mighty Miner changes his position to the horizontally mirrored position of himself. He is intangible while changing positions. He also drops a bomb in the position he originally was prior to using the ability, dealing medium area damage to enemies around it after 1 second. His bomb affects both ground and air units and will also knock them back 1.8 tiles. The ability goes on a 13-second cooldown after the duration ends. The Explosive Escape ability costs 1 Elixir to activate.

super-witch.name: Super Witch
super-witch.description: Summons Skeletons, shoots destructo beams, has glowing pink eyes that unfortunately don't shoot lasers.

elixir-golem.name: Elixir Golem
elixir-golem.description: Splits into two Elixir Golemites when destroyed, which split into two sentient Blobs when defeated. Each part of the Elixir Golem gives your opponent some Elixir when destroyed!

battle-healer.name: Battle Healer
battle-healer.description: With each attack, she unleashes a powerful healing aura that restores Hitpoints to herself and friendly Troops. When she isn't attacking, she passively heals herself!

skeleton-king.name: Skeleton King
skeleton-king.description: The King of the undead himself. He sometimes feels lonely (could be due to his non flattering features) and will summon friends to join him in the battle even after death. Tough guys have feelings too!

current.ability: The Skeleton King has a special ability, accessible from the rightmost side of the screen just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1-second delay, the Skeleton King activates his “Soul Summoning”, stopping in place momentarily before summoning a varied amount of Skeletons in a 4-tile radius around himself. The Skeletons spawn 1 at a time at random positions in the circle every 0.25 seconds. The number of Skeletons spawned is based on how many troops die (either from the player or the opponent) while he is deployed. It continues, even if the Skeleton King dies. When a troop is vanquished while the Skeleton King is in the Arena, the Skeleton King gains a “soul”, which spawns an additional Skeleton when his ability is used. With no souls, the Skeleton King will spawn 6 Skeletons, but with a maximum of 10 souls, he can summon 16 Skeletons. The amount of souls the Skeleton King h

super-lava-hound.name: Super Lava Hound
super-lava-hound.description: The Lava Hound is a majestic flying beast that attacks buildings. The Lava Pups are less majestic angry babies that attack anything.

super-magic-archer.name: Super Magic Archer
super-magic-archer.description: Not quite a Wizard, nor an Archer - he shoots a magic arrow that passes through and damages all enemies in its path. It's not a trick, it's magic!

archer-queen.name: Archer Queen
archer-queen.description: She is fast, deadly and hard to catch. Beware of her crossbow bolts and try not to blink - you might miss her!

current.ability: The Archer Queen has a special ability, accessible from the rightmost side of the screen just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1-second delay, the Archer Queen activates her “Cloaking Cape”, becoming invisible (untargetable by enemy troops), having a 80% increase in attack speed, and a massive decrease in movement speed for the entire 3.5-second duration of the ability. The ability goes on a 17-second cooldown after the duration ends. The Cloaking Cape ability costs 1 Elixir to activate.

santa-hog-rider.name: Santa Hog Rider
santa-hog-rider.description: Fast melee troop that targets buildings and can jump over the river. He followed the echoing call of "Hog Riderrrrr" all the way through the Arena doors.

golden-knight.name: Golden Knight
golden-knight.description: A warrior with luxurious hair and outstanding flexibility. Demonstrates his aerobics skills on demand.

current.ability: The Golden Knight has a special ability, accessible from the rightmost side of the screen just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1 second delay, the Golden Knight activates his "Dashing Dash", gaining a movement speed boost if he is not within 5.5 tiles of an enemy unit. Once a unit is in range, he dashes to it quickly, then dashes towards the closest enemy unit within a 5.5-tile radius (even if the previous unit was not destroyed). His dashes have invulnerability and deal increased damage, like the Bandit. He cannot dash into the same troop per ability use. He will stop dashing after dashing 10 times, if no other valid targets are within range, or if the last target hit is a Crown Tower. It is important to note that his movement speed boost cannot be reset or cancelled by The Log, Zap, Freeze or other things that will normally stop a charge. The ability goes on an 12 seco

super-ice-golem.name: Super Ice Golem
super-ice-golem.description: He's tough, targets buildings and explodes when destroyed, slowing nearby enemies. Made entirely out of ice... or is he?! Yes.

monk.name: Monk
monk.description:
Monk has spent many isolated years perfecting a new style of combat.

He fires off a 3-hit combo, with the last blow dealing extra Damage and pushing enemies back!

current.ability: The Monk has a special ability, accessible from the rightmost side of the screen just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1-second delay, the Monk activates his “Pensive Protection”, reducing all incoming damage he takes by 65% and reflect all incoming projectile-based ranged attacks back to the said offender. Spells are always reflected to the closest opposing Crown Tower. He cannot protect nearby allies from melee attacks, non-projectile ranged attacks and non-projectile spells. The Monk is impervious to all forms of knockback and the Tornado's pull during Pensive Protection's duration. The ability goes on a 17-second cooldown after the duration ends. The Pensive Protection ability costs 1 Elixir to activate.

super-archers.name: Super Archers
super-archers.description: A pair of lightly armored ranged attackers. They'll help you take down ground and air units, but you're on your own with hair coloring advice.

skeleton-dragons.name: Skeleton Dragons
skeleton-dragons.description: This pair of skeletal scorchers deal Area Damage and fly above the Arena. They also play a mean rib cage xylophone duet.

terry.name: Terry
terry.description: Terry and his trusty companion Pim Pim bring their unconventional Hog Riding skills to the Arena!

current.ability: The "Terry" has a special ability, accessible from the rightmost side of the screen just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1 second delay, the Terry jumps high, staying in the air for 2 seconds before crashing back down into the arena and dealing high damage and knockback to all troops in a 4-tile radius around his landing spot (similar to the Mega Knight’s jump and spawn damage). While in the air, he is immune to all forms of damage. The ability goes on a 7 second cooldown after the duration ends. The Hoggy Heights ability costs 1 Elixir to activate.

super-mini-pekka.name: Super Mini P.E.K.K.A
super-mini-pekka.description: The Arena is a certified butterfly-free zone. No distractions for P.E.K.K.A, only destruction.

mother-witch.name: Mother Witch
mother-witch.description:
Places a curse on enemy Troops with each attack. When a cursed Troop is destroyed, it turns into a building-targeting Hog that fights alongside the Mother Witch!

She also bakes great cookies.

electro-spirit.name: Electro Spirit
electro-spirit.description: Jumps on enemies, dealing Area Damage and stunning up to 9 enemy Troops. Locked in an eternal battle with Knight for the best mustache.

electro-giant.name: Electro Giant
electro-giant.description:
He channels electricity through his Zap Pack, a unique device that stuns and damages any Troop attacking him within its range.

Don't tell him that his finger guns aren't real! He'll zap you.

raging-prince.name: Raging Prince
raging-prince.description: Don't let the little pony fool you. Once the Prince gets a running start, you WILL be trampled. Deals double damage once he gets charging.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description:
This mystical creature will be reborn as an egg when destroyed. If it hatches, it returns to the fight! What an egg-cellent ability.

Being born again is tiring, so a hatched Phoenix will have slightly less Hitpoints and Damage (80% of its total).

cannon.name: Cannon
cannon.description: Defensive building. Shoots cannonballs with deadly effect, but cannot target flying troops.

goblin-hut.name: Goblin Hut
goblin-hut.description: Building that spawns Spear Goblins. Don't look inside... you don't want to see how they're made.

mortar.name: Mortar
mortar.description: Defensive building with a long range. Shoots big boulders that deal area damage, but cannot hit targets that get too close!

inferno-tower.name: Inferno Tower
inferno-tower.description: Defensive building, roasts targets for damage that increases over time. Burns through even the biggest and toughest enemies!

bomb-tower.name: Bomb Tower
bomb-tower.description: Defensive building that houses a Bomber. Deals area damage to anything dumb enough to stand near it.

barbarian-hut.name: Barbarian Hut
barbarian-hut.description: Building that periodically spawns Barbarians to fight the enemy. Time to make the Barbarians!

tesla.name: Tesla
tesla.description: Defensive building. Whenever it's not zapping the enemy, the power of Electrickery is best kept grounded.

elixir-collector.name: Elixir Collector
elixir-collector.description: You gotta spend Elixir to make Elixir! This building makes 8 Elixir over its Lifetime. Does not appear in your starting hand.

x-bow.name: X-Bow
x-bow.description: Nice tower you got there. Would be a shame if this X-Bow whittled it down from this side of the Arena...

tombstone.name: Tombstone
tombstone.description: Building that periodically spawns Skeletons to fight the enemy... and when destroyed, spawns 4 more Skeletons! Creepy!

furnace.name: Furnace
furnace.description: The Furnace spawns one Fire Spirit at a time. It also makes great brick-oven pancakes.

goblin-cage.name: Goblin Cage
goblin-cage.description: When the Goblin Cage is destroyed, a Goblin Brawler is unleashed into the Arena! Goblin Brawler always skips leg day.

goblin-drill.name: Goblin Drill
goblin-drill.description: Building capable of burrowing underground and appearing anywhere in the Arena. Spawns Goblins one at a time until destroyed. Then spawns a few more, to make sure everything nearby has been properly stabbed.

party-hut.name: Party Hut
party-hut.description: Building that spawns Spear Goblins. Don't look inside... you don't want to see how they're made.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Annnnnd... Fireball. Incinerates a small area, dealing high damage. Reduced damage to Crown Towers.

arrows.name: Arrows
arrows.description: Arrows pepper a large area, damaging all enemies hit. Reduced damage to Crown Towers.

rage.name: Rage
rage.description: Increases troop movement and attack speed. Buildings attack faster and summon troops quicker, too. Chaaaarge!

rocket.name: Rocket
rocket.description: Deals high damage to a small area. Looks really awesome doing it. Reduced damage to Crown Towers.

goblin-barrel.name: Goblin Barrel
goblin-barrel.description: Spawns three Goblins anywhere in the Arena. It's going to be a thrilling ride, boys!

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.description: Freezes and damages enemy troops and buildings, making them unable to move or attack. Everybody chill. Reduced damage to Crown Towers.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.description: Mirrors your last card played for +1 Elixir. Does not appear in your starting hand.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.description: Bolts of lightning damage and stun up to three enemy troops or buildings with the most hitpoints in the target area. Reduced damage to Crown Towers.

zap.name: Zap
zap.description: Zaps enemies, briefly stunning them and dealing damage inside a small radius. Reduced damage to Crown Towers.

poison.name: Poison
poison.description: Covers the area in a deadly toxin, damaging enemy troops and buildings over time. Yet somehow leaves the grass green and healthy. Go figure! Reduced damage to Crown Towers.

graveyard.name: Graveyard
graveyard.description: Surprise! It's a party. A Skeleton party, anywhere in the Arena. Yay!

the-log.name: The Log
the-log.description: A spilt bottle of Rage turned an innocent tree trunk into "The Log". Now, it seeks revenge by crushing anything in its path! Reduced damage to Crown Towers.

tornado.name: Tornado
tornado.description: Drags enemy troops to its center while dealing damage over time, just like a magnet. A big, swirling, Tornado-y magnet.

clone.name: Clone
clone.description: Duplicates all friendly troops in the target area. Cloned troops are fragile, but pack the same punch as the original! Doesn't affect buildings.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.description: Deals Damage per second to Troops and Crown Towers. Deals huge Building Damage! Does not affect flying units (it is an EARTHquake, after all).

barbarian-barrel.name: Barbarian Barrel
barbarian-barrel.description: It rolls over and damages anything in its path, then breaks open and out pops a Barbarian! How did he get inside?!

heal-spirit.name: Heal Spirit
heal-spirit.description:
A mischievous Spirit that leaps at enemies, dealing Damage and leaving behind a powerful healing effect that restores Hitpoints to friendly Troops!

R.I.P. Heal
2017 - 2020
Alas, we hardly used ye.

giant-snowball.name: Giant Snowball
giant-snowball.description: It's HUGE! Once it began rolling down Frozen Peak, there was no stopping it. Enemies hit are knocked back and slowed down. Reduced damage to Crown Towers.

royal-delivery.name: Royal Delivery
royal-delivery.description:
No need to sign for this package!

Dropped from the sky, it deals Area Damage to enemy Troops before delivering a Royal Recruit.

The empty box is also handy for espionage.

party-rocket.name: Party Rocket
party-rocket.description: Deals high damage to a small area. Looks really awesome doing it. Reduced damage to Crown Towers.

berserker.description: The Berserker is a Common card that is unlocked from the Jungle Arena (Arena 9) It spawns a fast, single-target, ground-targeting, melee, ground troop with moderate hitpoints and low damage. She appears as a kid who wears a brown dress made of bear skin and wristbands and a team-colored belt, has orange hair with two buns, eyes and eyebrows, a loose tooth, and a scar on her left chin, arms and legs, and wields a pair of cleavers. A Berserker card costs 2 Elixir to deploy.
berserker.name: Berserker

little-prince.description: The Little Prince is a card that is unlocked from the Silent Sanctuary (Arena 18). It spawns a single-target, air-targeting, long-ranged, ground troop with moderate hitpoints and low damage. The Little Prince's ability has him call upon a tank named Guardienne. She appears as a tall, muscular woman who has cyan eyes, blonde eyebrows, and a scar on her left eye, wields a giant sword, is dressed in a gray-colored armor, chain mail, and a team-colored cape, wears a helmet with a team-colored feather, brown gloves with metal guards, sandals and a belt with a gold buckle and silver details, and dons a blonde bowl cut under her helmet. The Little Prince himself appears similarly to the King, but has green eyes, rounded eyebrows, and coiffed curly hair, wears a chestplate and brown gloves, and wields a crossbow with gold platings. A Little Prince card costs 3 Elixir to deploy, and his ability c
little-prince.ability: The Little Prince has a special ability, accessible from the rightmost side of the screen just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1-second delay, the Little Prince activates his “Royal Rescue”, causing Guardienne to charge directly in front of the Little Prince and knock opposing ground troops away by 0-2 tiles (depends on how close the unit is to the sweet spot) while also doing moderate damage. After the charge is completed, Guardienne stays in the arena until she's taken out. Guardienne's stats are comparable to a Knight, having slightly less health and slightly less damage with their rest of their stats being identical. The ability goes on a 30-second cooldown after the duration ends. The Royal Rescue ability costs 3 Elixir to activate.
little-prince.name: Little Prince

goblinstein.description: The Goblinstein is a card that is unlocked from the Silent Sanctuary (Arena 18). It spawns a single-target, air-targeting, medium-ranged, ground troop with moderate hitpoints and low damage, and a single target, building-targeting, melee, ground troop with high hitpoints and low damage. The Goblinstein’s attacks will stun a targeted unit for 0.5 seconds. Being a Champion card, they will stay out of the player's card cycle, and only return once they are defeated. The Goblinstein's ability has him shoot an electric spark towards an antenna that is typically located on the Monster's head. The Goblinstein Doctor resembles a Goblin with white hair, wearing a silver-rimmed team-colored goggles with glowing orange lens, a satellite dish on his head with a team-colored strap, a white coat, tan gloves, and brown boots, and wields a controller. The Monster is a large, green Goblin with a square he
goblinstein.ability: The Goblinstein has a special ability, accessible from the rightmost side of the screen just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1-second delay, the Goblinstein activates his “Lightning Link”, creating an electric link between him and Monster. It damages by shocking nearby targets every 0.5 seconds up to 2 tiles away. This ability deals reduced damage to the Crown Tower. If the Monster has already been defeated, it will drop an antenna on the ground which is what the Goblinstein's electric link will target when the ability is activated. The Lightning Link ability costs 2 Elixir to activate.
goblinstein.name: Goblinstein

boss-bandit.description: The Boss Bandit is a card that is unlocked from the Royal Crypt (Arena 17). It spawns a single-target, ground-targeting, melee, ground troop with high hitpoints and high damage. If there are ground units between 3.5 and 6 tiles of her, she will stop moving and begin charging a dash attack which takes 0.8 seconds to execute, and will deal double damage. The Boss Bandit's ability allows her to get invisible for one second, then teleport 6 tiles behind her current spot. She appears as a woman who has teal eyes, light red hair in a ponytail and eyebrows, wields a wooden bat with three large golden bands, carries grenades, and wears a teal suit and a mask which covers her lower face, a dark brown cape with brass-colored linings, a golden headpiece, a team-colored waistcloth, brown gloves with team-colored handles and sandals, and long black socks. A Boss Bandit card costs 6 Elixir to deploy.
boss-bandit.ability: The Boss Bandit has a special ability, accessible from the rightmost side of the screen just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1 second delay, the Boss Bandit becomes invisible for 1 second, then teleports 6 tiles behind her original position. This allows her to escape any form of damage, as well as give her another dash if the troops are far away enough. The ability goes on a 3 second cooldown after the duration ends, but it can only be activated twice. The Getaway Grenade ability costs 1 Elixir to activate.
boss-bandit.name: Boss Bandit

goblin-machine.description: The Goblin Machine is a card that is unlocked from the Miner's Mine (Arena 15). It spawns a single-target, ground-targeting, melee, ground troop with high hitpoints and moderate damage. It also carries a rocket launcher on its back that can attack independently from the Goblin Machine. The rocket launcher is an area-damage, air-targeting, medium-ranged troop with very high damage. It has a blind spot, preventing it from attacking enemies inside it. It is a wood and metal mech with team-colored zig zag lines, spikes on the edges, a Goblin emblem in the center, and a team-colored rocket launcher on its back that has a striped team-colored rocket, all controlled by a Baby Goblin who has a magenta mohawk, carries a small hammer on his back, and wears light brown gloves. A Goblin Machine card costs 5 Elixir to deploy.
goblin-machine.name: Goblin Machine

ronin.description: The Ronin is a card that is unlocked from the Serenity Peak (Arena 14). It spawns one single-target, ground-targeting, melee, ground troop with high hit points and high damage. The Ronin can block the attack of opposing melee troops and deal double the damage to them every 3.5 seconds. He appears as a man wearing a viridian-colored robe with a beige trim and patterns, a straw hat with a team-colored tag on the side supported by a gold ring, which covers his eyes, a team-colored sash around his waist, and flip flops, has dark blue hair and a clean-shaved beard, carries two long scabbards attached to his hips, and wields two katanas. A Ronin card costs 5 Elixir to deploy.
ronin.name: Ronin

spirit-empress.description: The Spirit Empress is a card that is unlocked from the Miner's Mine (Arena 15). It spawns a single-target, air-targeting, medium-ranged, air troop with high hitpoints and high damage, or a single-target, ground-targeting, melee, ground troop with moderate hitpoints and high damage, depending on its Elixir cost. She appears as a woman who bears light blonde eyebrows and hair with two buns tied with team-colored knots, has heterochromic eyes, one golden and one blue, wears golden wristbands, an armor similar to the Battle Healer's, a team-colored cape and boots, and wields a scimitar with a light blue glow and a blue handle. She also appears to ride a blue dragon that looks similar to an Electro Dragon, except that it is paler and has glowing eyes. A Spirit Empress card costs 6 Elixir to deploy if the player has 6 or more Elixir stored, and 3 Elixir to deploy otherwise.
spirit-empress.name: Spirit Empress

goblin-curse.description: The Goblin Curse is an card that is unlocked from Serenity Peak (Arena 14). It is an area-damage, air-targeting spell with a medium radius and very low damage that is dealt every second for 6 seconds. If those troops are defeated, they would convert into Goblins. It is a lime-colored liquid encased in a large vial, which is secured by a thin rope, with a large, rectangular wooden cap with three golden hairs, a circular mouth, two large ears, and two green, gem-shaped eyes on the front, resembling a Baby Goblin. A Goblin Curse card costs 2 Elixir to deploy.
goblin-curse.name: Goblin Curse

vines.description: The Vines is an card that is unlocked from the Frozen Peak (Arena 8). It is a multi-damage, air-targeting spell with a small radius and high damage per second. When used, it will freeze the troop in place and render it unable to move or attack, and allow ground units to hit the trapped unit for 2.5 seconds. The three troops that are targeted are always the three that have the highest hitpoints within its radius. It appears as an aquamarine-colored potion encased in a large, diamond-shaped vial, that is strangled with a curling vine with thorns. It also has a lid which is made of wood with a thick, large thorn on top of it. A Vines card costs 3 Elixir to deploy.
vines.name: Vines

rune-giant.description: The Rune Giant is an card that is unlocked from Jungle Arena (Arena 9). It spawns a slow, single-target, building-targeting, melee, ground troop with high hitpoints and low damage. After a slight delay, she will throw an enhancement to a maximum of 2 allied troops on the Arena, increasing their damage for every 3rd attack. She appears as a large humanoid creature with long orange hair which covers her eyes and a large red nose, wearing a black suit, a brown apron and gloves, and a team-colored belt, and carries a pair of hammers. A Rune Giant card costs 4 Elixir to deploy.
rune-giant.name: Rune Giant

void.description: The Void is an card that is unlocked from the Miner's Mine (Arena 15). It is a multi-damage, air-targeting spell with a medium radius and various damage stages. The Void targets all troops inside its radius, dealing more damage to them the fewer there are inside its radius. It appears as a deep orange-amber liquid in a large vial, with dark purple decals around the corners and a cap on top. A Void card costs 5 Elixir to deploy.
void.name: Void

suspicious-bush.description: The Suspicious Bush is a card that is unlocked from the Rascal's Hideout (Arena 13). It spawns a medium speed, building-targeting, ground troop with very low hitpoints. Upon deployment, it spawns invisible as it moves towards the nearest building. Once the Suspicious Bush either reaches a building or is defeated, it will spawn two Bush Goblins, which are single-target, ground-targeting, melee, ground troops with low hitpoints and moderate damage. It is a tiny bush with team-colored flowers on it and a periscope mounted on top that has a white flower on it, while the Bush Goblins appear as Goblins that wear leaves on their heads and waists held by a rope, have team-colored body markings on their skin, and wield stone hammers. A Suspicious Bush card costs 2 Elixir to deploy.
suspicious-bush.name: Suspicious Bush

goblin-demolisher.description: The Goblin Demolisher is a card that is unlocked from the Spooky Town (Arena 12). It spawns an area-damage, ground-targeting, medium-ranged, ground troop with high hitpoints and moderate damage. When his hitpoints are lowered below 50%, he changes into a very fast, building-targeting troop that charges toward the nearest building, dealing high damage and inflicting knockback after defeat. He appears to be a larger Goblin with a small team-colored feather on his head and ash marks on his skin, wears stained brown goggles and a wooden barrel with straps filled with dynamite, and holds a dynamite in each hands. A Goblin Demolisher card costs 4 Elixir to deploy.
goblin-demolisher.name: Goblin Demolisher

knight-hero.description: The Heroic Knight is a card that is unlocked with 200 . It spawns one single-target, ground-targeting, melee, and ground troop with high hitpoints and moderate damage. The Heroic Knight takes the appearance of a man who has glowing yellow eyes, a bigger blond-colored mustache, goatee and eyebrows, and wears chainmail, a golden chestplate, a team-colored cape, a belt, platinum arm pads with a golden base, and golden shoes with platinum plates and straps on them, while wielding a large saber as his weapon and carrying a large platinum shield with a golden handle, base, mustache and goatee, along with a Hero Shard in the middle. A Heroic Knight card costs 3 to deploy.
knight-hero.ability: The Hero Knight has a special ability accessible from whatever side of the screen was put in, just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1-second delay, the Hero Knight activates his “Triumphant Taunt”, taunting every enemy troop and building in a 7.5-tiles range, causing them to attack him. He also gains a shield. Both the shield and the taunt effect last for 5 seconds, unless the former is destroyed, although enemy troops and buildings will still target him afterwards until he is defeated. The Triumphant Taunt ability costs 2 Elixir to activate.
knight-hero.name: Knight (héros)

giant-hero.description: The Hero Giant is a card that is unlocked with 200 hero fragments. It spawns one single-target, ground-targeting, melee, and ground troop with high hitpoints and moderate damage. The Heroic Giant takes the appearance of a colossal humanoid creature with glowing yellow eyes, blonde mutton chops, hair and eyebrows, wearing darker brown pants, a golden headband, and a team-colored belt with a golden base and details along with the Hero Shard in the center, while being bare-chested and wielding a pair of brass knuckles as his weapon with pearl and gold armbands. A Heroic Giant card costs 5 to deploy, and his ability costs an additional 2 to activate.
giant-hero.ability: The Hero Giant has a special ability accessible from whatever side of the screen was put in, just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1-second delay and when a unit gets in range, the Hero Giant activates his “Heroic Hurl”, grabbing the highest HP enemy troop within 2 tiles around him and throws them horizontally, also dealing damage to them when they land. While on the air, these troops are untargetable by ground-targeting troops and the Earthquake, but can still take damage from other spells. Air troops can be affected by the ability, but will take no damage when they land. The Heroic Hurl ability costs 2 Elixir to activate.
giant-hero.name: Giant (héros)

musketeer-hero.description: The Musketeer is a card that is unlocked in the Training Camp. It spawns one single-target, air-targeting, long-ranged, and ground troop with moderate hitpoints and moderate damage. The Heroic Musketeer takes the appearance of a woman who has golden glowing eyes, coiffed curly hair and eyebrows, and wears a gold breastplate, chainmail, a team-colored cape, a beige helmet with a gold handle in a similar style helmet as one of the Three Musketeers helmets, a belt, beige shoulder pads with gold handles as their base, brown gloves and boots with golden soles and chains, while carrying a beige blunderbuss-styled musket with a golden trigger and muzzle as her weapon with dark gray spheres as her ammunition. She also wields a turret with a large gold handle and base supported by a metal handle in-between and a long, gold and black striped tube, while having the same hat as the Musketeer. A Hero
musketeer-hero.ability: The Hero Musketeer has a special ability accessible from whatever side of the screen was put in, just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1-second delay, the Hero Musketeer activates her “Trusty Turret”, placing a turret 3 tiles forward of the Musketeer, which is used either as a distraction for regular troops, and as a building to attract win conditions. This turret has a lifetime of 10 seconds, meaning that this is meant to be used reactively as it's not meant to last that long, unless the building is destroyed before the Decay kills it. The Trusty Turret ability costs 3 to activate.
musketeer-hero.name: Musketeer (héros)

wizard-hero.description: The Hero Wizard is a card that is unlocked by spending 200 hero coins at once. The Hero Wizard takes the appearance of a man who has blonde eyebrows, mustache and goatee, and wears a beige cloak, a team-colored shirt, loincloth and pants, with all of them having a gold outline, a belt with a Hero Shard in the middle, two gold bracelets on his arms, and a pair of brown boots, while donning a pair of fiery golden wings. This card costs 5 to put on the arena and an additional 2 to activate his ability.
wizard-hero.ability: The Hero Wizard has a special ability accessible from whatever side of the screen was put in, just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1-second delay, the Hero Wizard activates his fiery flight, which makes him take flight for 5 seconds. While he is flying, not only he will get a 50% movement speed increase (now classified as fast), his fireballs also create 3 tile radius tornadoes, which does its own damage (reduced against crown towers), similar to the Evolved Valkyrie. The ability costs 2 to activate.
wizard-hero.name: Wizard (héros)

magic-archer-hero.description: The Heroic Magic Archer is a card that is unlocked with 200 . It spawns an area damage, air-targeting, long-ranged, ground troop with moderate hitpoints and moderate damage. The Magic Archer launches an attack that travels up to its maximum range, while piercing through enemies. He takes the appearance of a man with glowing yellow eyes, blonde hair with a team-colored stripe on the front side, bushy eyebrows and sideburns, wears a dark green tunic and pants, a beige cape with a gold lining and a Hero Shard on the center, a brown belt with a triangular copper rune and fingerless gloves with gold cuffs and a beige guard with a gold lining on the right, and dark brown boots with a gold handle on each, and wields a glowing yellow bow with beige stabilizers with gold trimmings. He also appears to be carrying a keychain on his waist that appears to be the Boss Bandit. A Heroic Magic Archer car
magic-archer-hero.ability: The Hero Magic Archer has a special ability accessible from whatever side of the screen was put in, just above the player's card slots in battle. When activated, the Magic Archer will teleport back, while leaving a decoy in his place. The next attack now shots 3 arrows that travel longer, but with less damage. The Triple Threat ability costs 2 Elixir to activate.
magic-archer-hero.name: Magic Archer (héros)

mega-minion-hero.description: The Heroic Mega Minion is a card that is unlocked with 200 . It appears as an enlarged Minion wearing a set of armor with a mask, chainmail, and a team-colored belt. A Heroic Mega Minion card costs 3 to deploy.
mega-minion-hero.ability: The Hero Mega Minion has a special ability accessible from whatever side of the screen was put in, just above the player's card slots in battle. When deployed, a marker will be deployed to the lowest hitpoint target. When that unit dies, the mark will move to the next unit. When the ability is pressed, Mega Minion will teleport to that tile, dealing damage. After defeating the target or 3.5 seconds pass, Mega Minion returns to his original position. Afterward, the Mega Minion will behave normally. The Wounding Warp ability costs 2 Elixir to activate.
mega-minion-hero.name: Mega Minion (héros)

barbarian-barrel-hero.description: The Heroic Barbarian is a card that is unlocked with 200 . It is an area-damage, ground-targeting spell with a short rectangular area and moderate damage. It can only be deployed on the player's own side. Once the spell reaches its destination, it spawns a single Barbarian. It is a spiked barrel with a Barbarian inside it.A Heroic Barbarian Barrel card costs 2 to deploy.
barbarian-barrel-hero.name: Barbarian Barrel (héros)

goblins-hero.description: The Heroic Knight is a card that is unlocked with 200 . It spawns four very fast, single-target, ground-targeting, melee, ground troops with low hitpoints and low damage. The Goblins take the appearance of small, green creatures with pointy ears, green eyes, dark green eyebrows, amber sclerae, and a large peach nose, while carrying daggers and wearing team-colored suspenders and wristbands, along with brown pants and shoes. A Heroic Goblins card costs 2 to deploy.
goblins-hero.name: Goblins (héros)

ice-golem-hero.description: The Hero Ice Golem is a card that is unlocked by unlocking 200 and choosing the Hero Ice Golem. The Heroic Ice Golem takes the appearance of a large creature made out of snow with glowing yellow eyes and golden ice shards on his head, with his hands being also colored golden and his nose and rocks on his spine being in the form of coal. He also dons a team-colored cape, two heavy golden armpads and gauntlets, and a gold headpiece with the Hero Shard in the center. This card costs 2to put on the arena and an additional 2 to activate his ability.
ice-golem-hero.ability: The Hero Ice Golem has a special ability accessible from whatever side of the screen was put in, just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1-second delay, the Hero Ice Golem activates his "Blizzard" ability, which generates a 4-tile aura radius that has 3 pulses, with each one slowing down enemy troops and dealing damage. The Snowstorm ability costs 2 to activate.
ice-golem-hero.name: Ice Golem (héros)

bowler-hero.description: The Heroic Bowler is a Epic card that is unlocked by using 200 Hero Coins on the card. It spawns a slow medium-ranged, ground-targeting troop that has high hitpoints and deals high area damage. Like his normal counterpart, he throws a projectile with a large area of effect that travels its maximum range, dealing knockback and piercing through enemies. He takes the appearance of a massive, indigo-skinned humanoid creature with glowing yellow eyes, wearing a white headband with golden outlines, athletic shorts with a leather belt with a Hero Shard in the middle, a plaster on his left arm with team-colored outlines, and golden-and-white sneakers, and carries a boulder that appears as a basketball and has glowing yellow eyes. A Heroic Bowler card costs 5 to deploy, and a further 2 to activate his ability.
bowler-hero.ability: The Hero Bowler has a special ability accessible from whatever side of the screen was put in, just above the player's card slots in battle. After 2.5sec of the ability pressed, the bowler will change the attack to a long-ranged mortar attack for 7.3sec. Getting a total of 3 shots during that duration.
bowler-hero.name: Bowler (héros)

dark-prince-hero.description: The Heroic Dark Prince is an card that is unlocked from the Royal Arena (Arena 7). It spawns an area-damage, ground-targeting, melee, ground troop with high hitpoints and high damage with shields in addition to his normal hitpoints. After he travels 3 tiles, he will begin to charge towards his target, and deals double damage if he hits the target whilst charging. The charge will hit all enemies in a 360º area around him. He is able to jump over the river. The Heroic Dark Prince takes the appearance of a man who has glowing yellow eyes, black eyebrows, dark brown hair, and is mostly covered in somber armor with golden spikes, accents and trim on it, wearing a bucket with a team-colored feather on his head and pearl white horns on the sides, a large pearl white belt with a golden spikes in the center and a gold trim, a team-colored cape, and brown sandals. He carries a golden-spiked mace a
dark-prince-hero.ability: The Hero Dark Prince has a special ability accessible from whatever side of the screen was put in, just above the player's card slots in battle. After pressing the ability, the Dark Prince will jump off the Rhino, dealing spawn damage on impact. The Rhino charges towards buildings, while the Dark Prince deals splash damage to troops but loses his charge in the process. The Destructive Dismount ability costs 3 Elixir to activate.
dark-prince-hero.name: Dark Prince (héros)
