berserker-hero.name: Berserker (héros)

balloon-hero.description: The Heroic Balloon is a card that is unlocked with 200 . It spawns a single-target, building-targeting, melee, air troop with high hitpoints and very high damage. When defeated, it drops a bomb which explodes after 3 seconds, dealing moderate damage. It is a hot air balloon with a team-colored envelope and a wooden basket with sacks held together by patches and ropes, and is piloted by a Bomber. A Heroic Balloon card costs 5 to deploy.
balloon-hero.ability: The Hero Knight has a special ability accessible from whatever side of the screen was put in, just above the player's card slots in battle. Once pressed, a skeletropper will fly towards the closest ground unit within 6 tiles, deling spawn damage. The skeletropper will the attack, dealing less damage to the crown tower. The Coffin Cadets ability costs 2 Elixir to activate.
balloon-hero.name: Balloon (héros)

knight-evolution.description: The Knight's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Knight with identical stats to the original. When he isn't attacking, he receives 60% less damage from all sources, staying active until the Evolved Knight deals damage to something. The Knight takes the appearance of a man who has purple eyes, a blond-colored mustache, beard and eyebrows, and wears chain mail and a chestplate, along with a team-colored sash and a belt, purple gloves with a golden stripe on them, and metal shoes with purple plates on them that have a golden knob on top of them, while holding a saber, that now has a golden handle. The chainmail in his head is now purple with a golden stripe on it, and he also has a big, purple shield with the Card Evolution symbol covering his right shoulder, acting as an armlet. The Knight's Evolution costs 3 and requires 2 to deploy.
knight-evolution.name: Knight (évolution)

archers-evolution.description: The Archers' Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns 2 Archers with a range 1 tile further than the originals. If there are units between 4 and 6 tiles of the Evolved Archers, they will shoot their Power Shot, which deals 25% bonus damage. The Archers take the appearance of women who have purple eyes, deep pink eyebrows and short hair with a ponytail, and wear golden bands on their arms, team-colored capes with a golden lining in the bottommost part of them, purple gloves, tunics and leggings, and a dark brown belt with a buckle, along with a bag and a quiver around their waists and on their backs respectively, while wielding a recurve bow with purple stabilizers and a golden handle, having arrows with purple fletchings and a dark purple point as their ammunition. The Archers' Evolution costs 3 and requires 2 to deploy.
archers-evolution.name: Archers (évolution)

skeletons-evolution.description: The Skeletons' Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns 3 Skeletons, with identical stats to the originals, in a triangle formation. Every time they attack, an additional Evolved Skeleton will spawn, for a maximum total of 8 Skeletons. They resemble small undead creatures with a skull that lacks a lower jaw, have purple eyes and a nose and a scar on their left eye, wield short purple swords, and wear a purple ushanka and a belt around their chests. The Skeletons' Evolution costs 1 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
skeletons-evolution.name: Skeletons (évolution)

barbarians-evolution.description: The Barbarians' Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns 5 Barbarians with hitpoints 10% higher than the originals. Every attack, their attack speed and movement speed increases by 30% for 3 seconds. They appear as bare-chested men who wield longer swords with a purple handle, have purple eyes, longer, brighter blond eyebrows, close-cropped hair and horseshoe moustaches, and wear three purple straps with golden buttons on them, which are held by a golden ring in the center, headband with a Card Evolution symbol in the middle, kilt, golden-spiked wristbands and sandals, along with a team-colored belt. The Barbarians' Evolution costs 5 Elixir and requires 1 cycle to deploy.
barbarians-evolution.name: Barbarians (évolution)

royal-recruits-evolution.description: The Royal Recruits' Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns 6 Royal Recruits with identical stats to the originals. After their shield is destroyed, they gain the ability to charge towards their target after traveling 2 tiles, dealing 2x damage if they hit the target whilst charging. They appear as men with large, round noses, wear wooden buckets with team-colored feathers, which cover their faces, metal gloves, an armor, a chainmail, a purple shirt, cape, pants and sandals, and a team-colored band on their right arm and belt with purple linings and a Card Evolution symbol in the center, and wield spears and wooden shields. The Royal Recruits' Evolution costs 7 Elixir and requires 1 cycle to deploy.
royal-recruits-evolution.name: Royal Recruits (évolution)

royal-giant-evolution.description: The Royal Giant Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Royal Giant with identical stats to the original. Every time he attacks, he will deal damage in a 2.5 tile radius around him, also knocking back enemy ground troops by 1 tile. His appearance is similar to that of a Giant, but he sports a dark indigo coat with gold linings and team-colored cuffs, a chainmail armor, a purple crown, team-colored pants and a belt with the Card Evolution symbol in the center and gold linings, wields a bigger Cannon with a large golden band, carries golden cannonballs, and has purple eyes, blonde eyebrows and friendly mutton chops. The Royal Giant's Evolution costs 6 Elixir and requires 1 cycle to deploy.
royal-giant-evolution.name: Royal Giant (évolution)

mortar-evolution.description: The Mortar's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Mortar with a hit speed 1 second faster than the original. Every attack that it does will also spawn a Goblin. It is a metallic cylindrical tube with a golden base, a wooden gimbal on each side with three purple studs on them which are held by purple and black metal stakes, gold chains and a Card Evolution symbol on the side, and a large, double-layered team-colored band near the muzzle, which is surrounded by two gold rings, with a Goblin located near the top. The Mortar's Evolution costs 4 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
mortar-evolution.name: Mortar (évolution)

bats-evolution.description: The Bats' Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns 5 Bats with hitpoints 50% higher than the original. Every time they attack, they heal themselves, having two healing pulses with a 0.5 second interval. The healing can overheal them, allowing their hitpoints to reach up to double of their initial ones. They resemble small, indigo bats with glowing pink eyes, fangs, brighter pink ears, snouts and lower wings, and purple underbellies and upper wings. The Bats' Evolution costs 2 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
bats-evolution.name: Bats (évolution)

firecracker-evolution.description: The Firecracker's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Firecracker with identical stats to the original. She shoots 1 projectile that when it ends, breaks into 5 shrapnel, which will continue travelling. Both the initial and small shrapnel will leave sparks behind, which will deal damage every 0.25 seconds and slow down enemy troops on them, similar to a Poison. The Firecracker resembles an Archer, except that she wears a team-colored headband, a navy and gray-colored tunic with a Card Evolution symbol in the middle, an indigo hood, gloves, belt with a gold buckle and buttons and boots with a rope tied to each of them, and carries a wooden rocket launcher with an indigo striped golden rocket inside it that has a golden fuse. The Firecracker's Evolution costs 3 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
firecracker-evolution.name: Firecracker (évolution)

wall-breakers-evolution.description: The Wall Breakers' Evolution is an card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns 2 Wall Breakers with identical stats to the originals. When defeated, they will explode, dealing high damage (but less against Crown Towers) and will spawn a Runner each, which is an area-damage, building-targeting, melee, ground troop with low hitpoints and moderate damage. They drop their dynamite at their target when attacking, destroying themselves on impact. They resemble Skeletons donning purple bandanas and gloves with golden cuffs, along with a team-colored belt with the Card Evolution symbol in the center, have purple eyes and a nose, ride larger, purple-spiked explosive barrels, and carry sticks of dynamite in their hands. The Wall Breakers' Evolution costs 2 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
wall-breakers-evolution.name: Wall Breakers (évolution)

ice-spirit-evolution.description: The Ice Spirit's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns an Ice Spirit with a splash radius 0.5 tiles larger than the original. When 3 seconds have passed after it hits an enemy, it will deal the same stun and damage to the enemy for 1.1 seconds. It resembles a small snowball with indigo eyes and a mouth, along with its hands, legs, teeth and crystals on its head being in the form of ice. The Ice Spirit's Evolution costs 1 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
ice-spirit-evolution.name: Ice Spirit (évolution)

valkyrie-evolution.description: The Valkyrie's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Valkyrie, with identical stats to the original. Every time she attacks, a Tornado will appear for half a second, pulling all units towards her, and dealing damage within a 5.5 tile radius around her. She takes an appearance as a woman who bears orange hair and eyebrows, have purple eyes and two piercings in her right ear, wears a purple suit, loincloth, wristcuffs and bands on her legs, brown straps with spikes on them and a Card Evolution symbol in the middle, and a team-colored waistcloth, wields a purple-tipped double-sided axe with a large, silver-plated golden knob on the bottom, and attacks with a powerful whirl of her axe along with a tornado effect. The Valkyrie's Evolution costs 4 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
valkyrie-evolution.name: Valkyrie (évolution)

tesla-evolution.description: The Tesla's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Tesla with identical stats to the original. After surfacing and deployment, the Tesla spawns an expanding electric pulse effect, dealing high damage while stunning all enemies in its radius. The stun lasts 0.5 seconds and covers a 6-tile radius. It appears to be a wooden lattice structure with a violet coil, cone and sphere with golden details placed on top which is surrounded by team-colored supports, a dark violet wire coiled around one of its pillar, and a dark violet wooden trapdoor with golden plates and hinges. The Tesla's Evolution costs 4 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
tesla-evolution.name: Tesla (évolution)

zap-evolution.description: The Zap's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It is a Zap with identical stats to the original. Once the initial hit is unleashed, the radius stays in the Arena, growing 0.5 tiles while doing the same damage and stun as the initial hit. It is a deep blue liquid filled inside a thin oblong vial. The vial appears with a purple lid, a golden neck, and a Card Evolution symbol in the middle, which is secured by a golden rope. The Zap's Evolution costs 2 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
zap-evolution.name: Zap (évolution)

bomber-evolution.description: The Bomber's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Bomber with identical stats to the original. After the initial throw, the bomb will bounce twice, 2.5 tiles apart in a straight line, dealing the same damage as the initial hit and hitting troops in an area as large as that of the initial hit. He appears as a Wall Breaker wearing a purple aviator hat with a gold lining and gold-rimmed team-colored aviation goggles with purple lens and gloves with golden cuffs and carries a purple-spiked black bomb. The Bomber's Evolution costs 2 Elixir and requires 2 cycle to deploy.
bomber-evolution.name: Bomber (évolution)

battle-ram-evolution.description: The Battle Ram's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Battle Ram with identical stats to the original. Once it starts charging, it deals damage to any troop on its way to its target and inflicts knockback. Once it reaches a building, it will bounce back and repeatedly deal damage to its target until it dies. Once destroyed, it will break and reveal 2 Evolved Barbarians underneath. It appears to be a battering ram consisting of a large, thick, heavy log with an attached metal ram head at the front that has purple eyes, horn tips and spikes on its neck, along with a metal chain at the back, carried by two Barbarians underneath. The Battle Ram's Evolution costs 4 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
battle-ram-evolution.name: Battle Ram (évolution)

wizard-evolution.description: The Wizard's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Wizard with identical stats to the original. Once deployed, a Fire Shield will appear around the Wizard, preventing him from dying in 1 attack. Once the shield is destroyed, all pushback capable troops within 3 tiles of the Wizard will be pushed back by 3 tiles and take high damage. He takes the appearance of a man who has glowing pink eyes, brown eyebrows, and a goatee, and wears a violet cloak with brass-colored linings and boots, a team-colored shirt, pants and wristbands, and a golden belt chain with the Card Evolution symbol in the center. The Wizard's Evolution costs 5 Elixir and requires 1 cycle to deploy.
wizard-evolution.name: Wizard (évolution)

royal-hogs-evolution.description: The Royal Hogs' Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns four Royal Hogs with stats identical to their originals. They deploy as flying troops rather than on the ground, unable to be attacked by ground-targeting troops. Upon attacking, or getting hurt, the hogs will fall to the ground, dealing low area damage on impact. They appear to be smaller versions of the Hog Rider's hog wearing team-colored knight-like helmets with the Card Evolution symbol on top and have wings. The Royal Hogs' Evolution costs 5 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
royal-hogs-evolution.name: Royal Hogs (évolution)

goblin-cage-evolution.description: The Goblin Cage's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Goblin Cage with identical stats to the original. Once a ground troop comes within 3 tiles of the building, they get pulled into the cage and they are attacked directly by the Goblin Cage, and any troop pulled will be freed. When defeated, it spawns a Goblin Brawler with identical stats to the original. It appears to be a wooden cage with four dark violet metal supports with a golden spike on them, a lock on the front with the Card Evolution symbol on it, and a pair of bars at each side, while the Goblin Brawler appears as a larger, buff Goblin with violet eyes, mohawk and unibrow with a golden piercing, has tattoos printed on his back and arms, and sports a striped white shirt and a gold chain with the Card Evolution symbol, along with violet pants and bands tied on his hands which extends till h
goblin-cage-evolution.name: Goblin Cage (évolution)

goblin-barrel-evolution.description: The Goblin Barrel’s Evolution is an card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It is a Goblin Barrel with identical stats to the original. When launched, a second Goblin Barrel is launched alongside the first one, which lands on its mirroring tile in the other lane. Once the second Goblin Barrel has hit the ground, it spawns three Decoy Goblins. which are single-target, ground-targeting, melee, ground troops with very low hitpoints and high damage. It is a purple-spiked wooden barrel with a purple Goblin emblem on it. The Decoy Goblins appear as dolls with light blonde hair, an "X" mark on their forehead, purple eyes with an "X" on them, and a wind-up key behind them, wear team-colored overalls, and wield a shorter version of the Goblins' daggers. The Goblin Barrel’s Evolution costs 3 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
goblin-barrel-evolution.name: Goblin Barrel (évolution)

furnace-evolution.description: The Furnace's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Furnace, with identical stats to the original. When the Furnace attacks, the spawn speed is decreased to 2.4sec, as well as spawn Fire Spirits to the side, instead of the front. It appears to be an amethyst cast-iron steam locomotive armor with golden spikes, limbs, and a Card Evolution symbol in the center, wearing purple gloves ane cape with golden linings, team-colored chainmail, a cracked metal witch-like hat on top with a golden band in the middle, and a golden grate in the center. It also holds a wooden staff with a cauldron placed on top that has a golden handle filled with bubbling magenta fluid in it, which resembles Elixir, along with a large amethyst knob on the bottom with golden spikes on it. The Furnace's Evolution costs 4 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
furnace-evolution.name: Furnace (évolution)

skeleton-barrel-evolution.description: The Skeleton Barrel's Evolution is a card unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Skeleton Barrel with hitpoints 25% higher and death damage 64% higher than the original. It spawns with 2 barrels, each with 7 Skeletons: one dropped when it reaches 75% hitpoints, and another dropped when it is defeated. It is a golden-spiked, dark brown, double barrel with a Card Evolution symbol on both sides chained to a pair of team-colored balloons with a violet skull printed on them and a small spike on top of them. The Skeleton Barrel's Evolution costs 3 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
skeleton-barrel-evolution.name: Skeleton Barrel (évolution)

dart-goblin-evolution.description: The Dart Goblin Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution shards. It spawns a Dart Goblin with identical stats to the original. When attacking a target, he will leave an area of effect poison, becoming stronger after multiple attacks. He resembles a Goblin, but wears a voodoo mask with purple eyes, team-colored face paint and a rope behind, leaves with circles and purple tips, and a Card Evolution symbol on top, purple pants, team-colored bands on his arm, and brown shoes, carries a purple potion, and holds a blowgun with purple paint. The Dart Goblin's Evolution costs 3 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
dart-goblin-evolution.name: Dart Goblin (évolution)

goblin-giant-evolution.description: The Goblin Giant's Evolution is an card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Goblin Giant with identical stats to the original. When his hitpoints are lowered below 50%, every 2.2 seconds, the Goblin Giant will passively summon a Goblin. The Goblin Giant resembles a colossal, aquamarine-skinned Goblin with a deep pink nose, purple eyes, sideburns and goatee, wearing a purple aviator hat with a Card Evolution symbol and pants with gold stitches and golden linings on both of them, along with a purple backpack with ropes tied on the sides and team-colored suspenders, carries a dagger with a purple handle, and has two ropes tied on his arms and white bands tied on his legs. The Goblin Giant's Evolution costs 6 Elixir and requires 1 cycle to deploy.
goblin-giant-evolution.name: Goblin Giant (évolution)

hunter-evolution.description: The Hunter Evolution is an card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Hunter with identical stats to the original. The Evolved Hunter will throw a net at the closest unit every 5 seconds. The net will freeze the troop in place and render it unable to move or attack, and allow ground units to hit the trapped unit for 3 seconds. He appears as a man who wears a team-colored coonskin cap with purple hair, a golden stripe and a Card Evolution symbol in the middle, a brown cloth, gloves, belt, pants and boots, an indigo shirt, and team-colored wristlets, is armed with a double-barreled shotgun, wield nets with purple points, and has fuzzy black eyebrows and mustache covering his eyes and mouth respectively. The Hunter's Evolution costs 4 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
hunter-evolution.name: Hunter (évolution)

executioner-evolution.description: The Executioner's Evolution is an card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns an Executioner with identical stats to the original. The Executioner launches an axe that travels up to its maximum range, and returns back to him after some time, while piercing through enemies in both ways. If an enemy troop is within 3.5 tiles from the start of the attack, it will be knocked back, while also receiving extra damage. They will also receive the extra damage on the returning phase on the attack. He resembles a shirtless man with glowing pink eyes, wears a purple mask with gold stitches, glove with a golden stripe and boots, a team-colored kilt and pants, a belt, and a pair of straps, carries a double-sided axe with a Card Evolution symbol and a large golden knob on the bottom, and has an axe-shaped tattoo on his arm, which glows alongside his axe whenever the axe is within 3.5 tiles
executioner-evolution.name: Executioner (évolution)

inferno-dragon-evolution.description: The Inferno Dragon's Evolution is a card unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns an Inferno Dragon with identical stats to the original. Once the Evolved Inferno Dragon defeats a troop on whatever damage stage it was in, it remains on that damage state until 9 seconds of duration if the Evolved Inferno Dragon doesn't hit a troop, or it is reset by a stun attack. After 20 seconds of damage, the Evolved Inferno Dragon will reach a 4th damage stage which deals twice the damage of the 3rd stage. It resembles a Baby Dragon with a helmet that have golden spikes, a silver-rimmed, team-colored goggles with glowing lens and a golden button, a transparent, team-colored fuel tank on its back with a hose, two stubby magenta wings, hands, feet and spikes on its back, and fires a magenta beam. The Inferno Dragon's Evolution costs 4 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
inferno-dragon-evolution.name: Inferno Dragon (évolution)

lumberjack-evolution.description: The Lumberjack's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Lumberjack with identical stats to the original. When the Lumberjack dies, his ghost will spawn. The ghost has unlimited health, and can't be targeted by troops, buildings and towers, but can be affected by spells, and will disappear after a short time outside of the initial Rage Spell. The Lumberjack resembles a ginger-haired Barbarian with a beard, purple eyes, and a scarlet nose, wearing a brown belt, purple ushanka with the Card Evolution symbol in the center and kilt with gold linings, and team-colored wristbands and sandals, wielding an axe with a purple-tipped blade, a darker handle, and a golden knob on the bottom, and carries a Rage Spell on his shoulder. His ghost appears identical to him, but has pale skin and tongue, white hair, beard, mustache and eyebrows, and his axe's blade is cyan.
lumberjack-evolution.name: Lumberjack (évolution)

musketeer-evolution.description: The Musketeer's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Musketeer, with identical stats to the original. After deployment, she will gain 3 infinite-range attacks that will target the closest troop or building from anywhere in the Arena in front of her, dealing 1.8 times the damage of her normal attacks. The Musketeer takes the appearance of a woman who has purple eyes, coiffed curly hair with a ponytail, eyebrows and lipstick, and wears a royal blue tunic with a purple cloth on it, a purple cape with a Card Evolution symbol in the center and gloves, a metal helmet with a team-colored feather and a tiny crater on it, a dark brown belt and boots with dark purple straps, while carrying a blunderbuss-styled musket as her weapon with dark gray spheres as her ammunition and a scope on top. The Musketeer's Evolution costs 4 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deplo
musketeer-evolution.name: Musketeer (évolution)

electro-dragon-evolution.description: The Electro Dragon's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns an Electro Dragon with identical stats to the original. The Evolved Electro Dragon launches an attack that hits its target, which will arc and strike up to 2 other targets within 4 tiles of each other. It will stun affected troops for 0.5 seconds. After the first 3 targets are hit, this attack will continue bouncing infinitely between all troops until only one remains alive. The attack will deal 33% less damage, travel 80% slower, and no longer stun the affected troops. The Electro Dragon is a small blue dragon with purple eyes, tongue and spikes on its back, deep pink spots and wings, team-colored underbelly, and a small gold armor on its head. The Electro Dragon Evolution costs 5 Elixir and requires 1 cycle to deploy.
electro-dragon-evolution.name: Electro Dragon (évolution)

giant-snowball-evolution.description: The Giant Snowball's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It is a Giant Snowball with a slowdown duration 1 sec longer than the original. Once the initial hit is unleashed, the affected troops get pulled into it and the Giant Snowball rolls on the ground for 4.5 tiles similarly to the Barbarian Barrel. When it finishes its roll, the troops are freed. It is an oversized snowball surrounded with indigo shards, and has a sword on top and a spear on the bottom, along with a hand and a foot sticking out of it. The Giant Snowball's Evolution costs 2 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
giant-snowball-evolution.name: Giant Snowball (évolution)

royal-ghost-evolution.description: The Evolved Royal Ghost is a card that is unlocked from the Spooky Town (Arena 12). It spawns a fast, area-damage, ground-targeting, melee, ground troop with high hitpoints and high damage. Upon deployment, he will spawn invisible and will only turn visible once he attacks. If he is in his invisible state, he will not be targeted by opposing units but can still be hit by area damage or spells. When he is not fighting any unit for 1.8 seconds, he will become invisible again. The Royal Ghost hovers, meaning he is targeted as a ground unit, but travels similar to air units. The Royal Ghost resembles an undead King who has glowing purple eyes, pale skin, white beard, moustache and eyebrows, wears a crown with purple jewels, dark gauntlets and chainmail, a team-colored robe and a purple cape with gold linings and shoes, and a dark gray belt, and wields a sword with a purple glow and the Card
royal-ghost-evolution.name: Royal Ghost (évolution)

baby-dragon-evolution.description: The Baby Dragon's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Baby Dragon with identical stats to the original. The Evolved Baby Dragon produces a 8x9 square area of a gust of wind around it that slows enemy troops by 30% and speeds up allies by 30%. After death, the wind will linger for about 2 seconds. The Baby Dragon is a small, spring green dragon with short, stubby, darker team-colored wings, feet and tongue, plum eyes, horns and larger spikes on its wings and back, yellow sclera, and a purple back, and fires a bright, glowing fireball that leaves a purple trail. The Baby Dragon's evolution card costs 4 Elixir to deploy and requires 2 cycle to deploy.
baby-dragon-evolution.name: Baby Dragon (évolution)

goblin-drill-evolution.description: The Goblin Drill Evolution is an Epic card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Goblin Drill with identical stats to the original. Once its hitpoints reach 66% and 33% respectively, the Goblin Drill will resurface nearby, leaving a Goblin behind each time it's destroyed. If the Goblin Drill is not deployed next to the Crown Towers, it will resurface in the same spot. If the Goblin Drill is deployed next to the Crown Towers, it will resurface 90 degrees around a Crown Tower. It appears as a building with purple spikes that have golden frames as their base, a wooden hull, a Card Evolution-shaped golden hatch, a purple Goblin emblem on the side, a team-colored stripe in the center, and a purple metal drill on its top. The Goblin Drill Evolution costs 4 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
goblin-drill-evolution.name: Goblin Drill (évolution)

cannon-evolution.description: The Cannon's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Cannon with identical stats to the original. After deployment, the Cannon shoots 9 cannonballs in 2 rows, 5 on the top row and 4 on the bottom, which deals area damage and inflicts knockback. It appears as a large dark metal barrel mounted on a four-legged wooden mount with a purple metal plate, legs and supports reinforced with gold chains, with a purple muzzle, two team-colored ridges, one midway and the other at the rear, along with a Card Evolution symbol in between, and a metal wing attached to both sides. The Cannon's Evolution costs 3 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
cannon-evolution.name: Cannon (évolution)

witch-evolution.description: The Witch's Evolution is an card unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Witch with identical stats to the original. Once a Skeleton that the Evolved Witch has spawned is defeated, she is healed. This healing can overheal, allowing her to achieve 24% more hitpoints at its maximum capacity. The Evolved Witch takes an appearance as a woman who has glowing pink eyes and violet eyebrows, wears a violet cloak with gold linings, a ram face on top and two horns on the sides and dress, a dark gray top, team-colored armlets, darker purple lipstick, and a belt with the Card Evolution symbol in the middle, and wields a staff with a skull on top. The Witch's Evolution costs 5 Elixir and requires 1 cycle to deploy.
witch-evolution.name: Witch (évolution)

skeleton-army-evolution.description: The Skeleton Army's Evolution is an Card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns 15 Skeletons in a scatter formation, with General Gerry at the back. When the Skeletons are defeated, their shadows will spawn. The shadows have unlimited hitpoints, and can't be targeted by troops, buildings and tower troops, but can be affected by spells. When General Gerry is defeated, all the shadows are defeated as well. Gerry appears as a Guard with purple eyes, wears a helmet with a golden handle and a team-colored crest on top and a purple cape with gold linings, and carries a spear with an attached purple banner that has a skull printed on it and a wooden shield with the Card Evolution symbol on it. The Skeleton Army's Evolution costs 3 Elixir and requires 2 cycles to deploy.
skeleton-army-evolution.name: Skeleton Army (évolution)

princess-evolution.description: The Princess's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns an evolved Princess with area-damage, air-targeting, very long-ranged, ground troop with low hitpoints and moderate damage. She resembles a woman with purple eyes, long black hair with a gray stripe and eyebrows, wearing a blue robe with team-colored sleeves and a woolen base, a cape with a Card Evolution symbol on the front, an ice crown with a golden circlet, a purple belt with a crown symbol, gloves and leggings, and dark brown boots, and wields a bow with a team-colored handle, dark purple stabilizers with golden edges and woolen details, and arrows with team-colored fletchings and icy points. The Princess's Evolution costs 3 Elixir to deploy.
princess-evolution.ability: Once the Evolved Princess spawns, her first shot will slow down enemies within a 3-tile radius (by 30%, just like the Ice Wizard) for 7 seconds. After this first shot, she will fire two normal shots, and the third one will slow them down. Additionally, when the Evolved Princess dies, she leaves behind a 3-tile area-damaging slowdown zone that also lasts 7 seconds.
princess-evolution.name: Princess (évolution)

mega-knight-evolution.description: The Mega Knight's Evolution is a card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a Mega Knight with identical stats to the original. Every second time he attacks, the Evolved Mega Knight will do an uppercut, launching the targeted troop back 4 tiles towards the nearest enemy Crown Tower. He resembles a Knight with magenta eyes, black eyebrows, and glowing pink sclerae, clothed in heavy, massive amethyst armor, a helmet with a team-colored feather on top, large, purple-spiked maces with golden frames and handles as their base, purple chainmail with gold linings, and a team-colored belt with golden spikes and a Card Evolution symbol in the middle. The Mega Knight’s Evolution costs 7 Elixir and requires 1 cycle to deploy.
mega-knight-evolution.name: Mega Knight (évolution)

pekka-evolution.description: The P.E.K.K.A's Evolution is an card that is unlocked with 6 Evolution Shards. It spawns a P.E.K.K.A with identical stats to the original. Once the Evolved P.E.K.K.A takes out a troop or building, a butterfly will spawn around her sword, healing 3.5%-15% of her original hitpoints, the magnitude of the heal being determined by the defeated unit's hitpoints. This healing can overheal, allowing her to achieve 50% more hitpoints at its maximum capacity. She appears as a robot-looking troop larger than the Mini P.E.K.K.A. clothed in heavy dark gray armor with gold linings, dark-colored stabilizers and two large magenta spikes on her shoulders, wears team-colored straps with the Card Evolution symbol in the center, has magenta eyes and horns, and wields a large, magenta-glowing metal sword with a golden handle. The P.E.K.K.A's Evolution costs 7 Elixir and requires 1 cycle to deploy.
pekka-evolution.name: P.E.K.K.A (évolution)

mini-pekka-hero.description: The Heroic Mini P.E.K.K.A. is a card that is unlocked with 200 hero fragments. It spawns one single-target, ground-targeting, melee, and ground troop with high hitpoints and high damage. The Heroic Mini P.E.K.K.A takes the appearance of a robot-looking troop similar to Mini P.E.K.K.A. who wears gold metallic armor with two pearl white horns, shoulder and arm pads, golden spikes on his arms and a single round glowing eye, along with a team-colored cape and faulds, while wielding both a cracked refined sword with a pearl white base, a golden hilt and a wooden grip and a golden spatula with a small golden spike near the top. A Heroic Mini P.E.K.K.A. card costs 4 to deploy, and his ability costs an additional 1 to activate.
mini-pekka-hero.ability: The Heroic Mini P.E.K.K.A. has a special ability accessible from whatever side of the screen was put in, just above the player's card slots in battle. After a 1-second delay, the Mini P.E.K.K.A. activates his "Breakfast Boost", immediately eats all the pancakes he cooked, granting him extra Levels and healing himself for 30%. Heroic Mini P.E.K.K.A. can constantly gain progress for his pancake meters. He will need 22 seconds to get one pancake meter filled, but he can also get 10 seconds of progress with every attack. Every filled pancake meter increases the Levels gained when his ability is used by 1, except the last meter grants 2 extra Levels. With no meters, the Heroic Mini P.E.K.K.A. will gain 1 Level, but with a maximum of 3 meters, he can gain 5 Levels. The amount of meters the Heroic Mini P.E.K.K.A. has can be seen in a golden bar above his hitpoint bar.The Breakfast Boost ability
mini-pekka-hero.name: Mini P.E.K.K.A. (héros)
